{{Cancer}}
Cancer 1 is the 197th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 1st day of Cancer, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 29, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 8宮1日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 197|Chapter 197]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152217}}.
